description.en: Free Tailwind CSS components and sections designed for rapid web prototyping.
description.zh: 专为快速 Web 原型打造的免费 Tailwind CSS 基础组件与整页切片。

content.en: Velora UI by Colorlib is a free, modern Tailwind CSS UI library created for developers and designers who need production-ready components and marketing sections. Featuring clean HTML structure and lightweight CSS, Velora accelerates initial site scaffolding.
content.zh: Velora UI 是由知名设计团队 Colorlib 出品的免费现代化 Tailwind CSS 组件库。全库强调极简轻量的 HTML 结构与易拆解的原子化类名，提供现成的导航栏、营销区块与基础控件，能够显著加速新项目从原型到原码的搭建进程。
